description: Language-independent Frontend Protocol reducer conformance. Every case owns a complete initial normalized state, ordered protocol inputs, complete expected normalized State and typed Changes, explicit cursors/freshness/synchronization outcome, connection disposition, and nullable error.

inputContract.events.synchronizing: Required boolean. False applies a live batch to Current state; true validates/applies a replay batch inside a synchronization stream.
inputContract.projection.continuity: Compares retained and candidate inputs with the canonical language-independent projection fingerprint and requires the literal expectedCompatible decision.
inputContract.projection.snapshot.response: Marks acceptance of the internal snapshot.get response after an incompatible replay has been fully validated, before the replacement Snapshot stream.
inputContract.snapshot: Every successful snapshot reduction contributes state.replaced to expectedChanges, including initial/setup snapshots; a rejected snapshot contributes no change.
inputContract.welcome: Carries the server-selected synchronization mode and begins replay rebinding/staging; a server-selected snapshot waits for the following Snapshot without replaying retained state.
